title: Pay someone far away
scanLink: Point the camera at your friend’s pay link, or paste it.
notALink: That is not a pay link for this app. Ask your friend to share it again.
failed: The payment could not be made. Nothing was sent: try again.
reviewLine: {{name}} gets {{amount}} {{symbol}} in their wallet when a phone with internet sends it on. If none does before {{deadline}}, it isn't paid and the money stays yours, in your reserve.
pendingWarning: A payment is still on its way
privacy: People nearby who pass it on can't see who pays or how much. The Lateo server sees the payment and the network of the phone that sent it on.
offlineNote: You are offline: a phone nearby with internet has to take it.
onlineNote: You are online: it is sent to the network now.
receiveIntro: Share this so people can pay you from anywhere. It shows your wallet address and name.
name: Your name
linkLabel: Your pay link as a QR code
needsAccount: To be paid from far away you need a USDC account in your wallet. Creating it costs a small network fee.

detail.expiredNote: No phone with internet sent it on in time. Nothing was paid; the money stays yours, in your reserve.
